verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any capability for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows, such as cron jobs or scheduled workflow triggers. Vercel Workflows is described as durable multi-step execution with retries, waiting for events and resuming after crashes, which is not a recurring schedule. The only schedule-related item is regenerating static pages on a schedule, an adjacent cache feature rather than general job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
